Built from heavyweight 320 GSM interlock cotton for a solid, structured feel that doesn’t lose shape. Clean in daylight — but the moment light hits, the reflective print comes alive, hitting hard with a sharp, luminous glow.

Each piece is made only after you order — freshly produced, precisely checked, and tailored to your size.

Finished with high-intensity reflective printing designed to stand out at night without fading or cracking over time.

Why Felicite

• 320 GSM premium interlock cotton
• High-intensity reflective print (lights up in flash/night)
• Day-to-night transformation look
• Sweat-resistant, structured fabric
• Boxy waist-length oversized fit
• Made-to-order, QC checked

name: Stone Wash Hoodie
description:
Crafted from heavyweight 450 GSM cotton, finished with a refined acid wash for a rich, worn-in character and depth. The fabric feels dense yet comfortable, holding a structured drape with a naturally aged look.

Designed in an oversized boxy silhouette that sits clean and balanced.

Each piece is made after order — freshly produced, carefully inspected, and tailored to your size.

Why Felicite

• 450 GSM premium acid-washed cotton
• Rich, unique washed finish (no two identical)
• Heavyweight, structured feel
• Oversized boxy fit
• Made-to-order, QC checked
